dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: trajectory_data owns schema, trajectory_collector owns pairing, training_setup owns models and optimizers, and the script is the composition root

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Validated immutable configs and datasets are exported from fada_context; no caller traverses private model or environment state

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Data depends on the FADA architecture, collector depends on data, setup depends on model core, and the outer script composes them without cycles

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Both environments close in finally; paired reset snapshot is restored before each branch; persistence reload is validated before gradient probes

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Existing Planner-IDM training and playback paths are unchanged; new behavior is opt-in through one standalone preflight command

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Evidence explicitly claims readiness only and records training_started=false, optimizer_steps=0, and unproved quality gates

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Context receives only fault observation/action history and command; healthy future is a separate target; full fault sequences enforce contiguous next-state identity

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Disjoint optimizer parameter identity is asserted; Planner/IDM require_grad is false; real backward probes show nonzero trainable gradients with every parameter tensor unchanged

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema and exact FADA architecture are checked on weights-only reload; checkpoint SHA and fault identity persist; dynamics quality and policy improvement are explicitly deferred
